gates.capability: Verify short-lived Matrix identity proofs without putting credentials in URLs
gates.blockReason: This optional admission extension is disabled and is not a beta release requirement. The standardized Matrix OpenID userinfo flow places its assertion in a URL query, so Mesh fails closed until a reviewed POST-capable verifier can validate the issuing service, user, audience, purpose, subject, expiry, and replay state.
gates.nextAction: Approve and implement a POST-capable verifier contract, then pass expired, replayed, malformed, wrong-user, wrong-service, cross-purpose, and credential-leak acceptance tests against a live independently hosted account.

gates.capability: Issue one-use registration admission and invite users with least privilege
gates.blockReason: This optional admission extension is disabled and is not a beta release requirement. Synapse registration-token administration has no admission-only scope, so Mesh will not give the admission service a server-admin credential; token issuance and the non-admin bot membership/power workflow remain unavailable by default.
gates.nextAction: Approve a least-privilege issuer and bot-provisioning design, provision the bot only in admitted communities and child rooms, then pass live issue, revoke, expiry, room-membership, power, recovery, and credential-rotation tests.

gates.capability: Provide private authoritative moderation audit history
gates.blockReason: Authoritative audit history is outside the beta claim and is not a beta release requirement. Ordinary room events cannot prove historical moderator authority and are forgeable by members, so Mesh presents only operational moderation outcomes and audit retrieval fails closed until an authoritative design is approved.
gates.nextAction: Approve an access-restricted append-only storage and federation threat model, then pass sender provenance, historical authorization, failed-outcome, forgery, demotion, cross-community, malformed-event, replay, retention, export, and unauthorized-reader tests.
